verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a code-first library: auth config lives in version-controlled code with "no dashboard clicks," an official CLI exists (`npx auth init`, a documented CLI page, a one-command DB setup noted by a user), and server-side `auth.api` methods allow programmatic, non-browser use. However, one hands-on user reports that the request-header-based design made admin scripts and tests "very hacky," since plugins would not run otherwise. missing for 10: explicit docs on CI/headless usage (non-interactive CLI flags, running migrations in pipelines, test harness guidance), clean header-free scripting for admin/test automation, independent corroboration of smooth CI use.
